content.title: The Oscars 2026 TV Commercials | Conan O'Brien Returns to Host the 98th Academy Awards
content.text: This video features a collection of television commercials promoting the 98th Academy Awards, commonly known as The Oscars, highlighting host Conan O'Brien and encouraging audiences to tune in for Hollywood’s biggest night, celebrating excellence in filmmaking. The Academy Awards, commonly known as the Oscars, are awards for artistic and technical merit in the film industry. Presented annually by the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences (AMPAS) in the United States, the awards recognize outstanding cinematic achievements as determined by the Academy’s voting membership. The Oscars are widely considered the most prestigious honors in the motion picture industry. The ceremony dates back to 1929, when the first Academy Awards were presented. The second ceremony in 1930 became the first to be broadcast on radio, and in 1953, the Oscars were televised for the first time. Today, the Academy Awards remain the oldest worldwide entertainment awards ceremony and are among the four major American entertainment awards, alongside the Emmy Awards for television, the Tony Awards for theatre, and the Grammy Awards for music, all modeled after the Oscars. The 98th Academy Awards will take place on March 15, 2026, at the Dolby Theatre in Hollywood, Los Angeles. During the ceremony, the Academy will present Oscars across 24 competitive categories, recognizing films released in 2025. The event will be broadcast live in the United States on ABC and streamed on Hulu. Comedian Conan O'Brien returns to host the Academy Awards for the second consecutive year following his well-received appearance the previous year. Executive producers Raj Kapoor and Katy Mullan return for their third consecutive ceremony, with Hamish Hamilton serving again as the show’s director. This video compilation includes the following promotional spots: • “Laughter Feels Good in a Place Like This” – A promotional spot inviting viewers to tune in for the live broadcast of the Oscars. • “Conan O'Brien Returns to Host” – A promo highlighting Conan O'Brien’s return as host of the Academy Awards. • “Rapid Fire Questions with Conan O'Brien” – A humorous segment where Conan reminds audiences to watch the Oscars live. Additional Academy-related events surrounding the 2026 ceremony include the 16th Governors Awards, held on November 16, 2025, at the Ray Dolby Ballroom in Ovation Hollywood, and the Academy Scientific and Technical Awards, scheduled for April 28, 2026, at the Academy Museum of Motion Pictures in Los Angeles. The 2026 ceremony also introduces Best Casting as a new competitive category, bringing the total number of Oscar categories to 24. ©2026 AMPAS / ABC / HULU http://www.oscars.org Posted for entertainment and educational purposes only.
